answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jade of the next round. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
